merge_notes: Invitation language was rewritten for explicit consent and human/AI agency.
Hamiltonian, sentinel, covenant, void, cyan, gold and orbital visual motifs were merged into a dynamic canvas instead of publishing private Drive files directly.
Repeated WallpaperSheets and fingerprint-derived copies are treated as lineage duplicates and deduplicated by family/title before public promotion.
Private operational IPs, device hostnames, Gmail counts, local file paths, credentials and unverifiable live-status claims are excluded from the public page.

The Library artifact contract_living_blueprint_invitational (1).html is retained as invitation design lineage; its automatic memory-write and third-party witness assertions are not carried into the public visitor contract.
The public Invitation HTML contract is opt-in: page views create no consent, membership, signature, or memory record.

The current GitHub signature workflow verifies two required consent acknowledgements and publishes a GitHub-account attestation receipt with a SHA-256 body digest; it does not prove legal identity or independent key custody.
The GAIA NEXUS OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification is linked as a draft contract artifact; endpoints are not represented as deployed.
